name: Zen Lotus Pond
subtitle: Backyard lotus water garden
lede: Filtered, jasmine-flanked lotus water garden with Buddha and simple moving water.
nextAction: Choose the permanent main pump and mechanical/biological filter for the Brownstone Manhattan pond.
goals: Clean moving water with predictable upkeep
Start fishless while making the filtration fish-ready for a possible future addition

siteConstraints.climate: Very hot Arizona summers; temperatures can reach about 110°F
siteConstraints.maintenanceTarget: A few minutes weekly plus periodic filter cleaning
siteConstraints.designIntent: Brownstone rectangular pond with lotus, Buddha, gentle fountain and jasmine

budget.note: Target budget and phase estimates are maintained in the cost plan.

shopping.item: Algreen Manhattan 40-inch Balcony Planter & Pond — Brownstone

shopping.note: Use as the visible gentle fountain, not the main filter.

shopping.item: Adjustable main pond pump, approximately 300–500 GPH rated
Tubing, flow control and quiet return fittings

phases.name: Lotus Nursery
phases.summary: Keep the lotus seedlings healthy while the permanent pond is built.

phases.name: Pond Decision
phases.summary: Brownstone Algreen Manhattan pond purchased from Wayfair for $146.19 all-in.

phases.name: Pump + Filter + Fountain
phases.summary: Install permanent circulation and filtration sized for the pond now and possible small fish later.

phases.name: Structure / Liner
phases.summary: Only add structural or liner work if the final installation requires it.

phases.name: Jasmine
phases.summary: Frame the pond with two white planters and black jasmine trellises.

phases.name: Lotus + Buddha
phases.summary: Place lotus, Buddha and gentle fountain while preserving open water.

phases.name: Lighting
phases.summary: Add restrained warm accent lighting after the pond is stable.

phases.name: Future State — Fish Ready Prep
phases.summary: Reassess whether a small fish population is appropriate after the pond has proven stable through Arizona seasons.

decisions.decision: Brownstone Algreen Manhattan 40-inch pond purchased from Wayfair.
Start fishless; revisit a small fish population in about one year.

maintenance.task: Remove debris/string algae and check water level
